row.body: The tailor’s fitting card is stamped complete before the customer’s pickup time; a note asks staff to leave the back door open for the return van.
row.title: A fitting appointment moved

sidecar.gloss: A fitting is closed before its pickup and the return van arrives.
sidecar.rival_reading: A supply crew could have used the same return van and fitting room; the card does not show why the schedule changed.
